title: LaZagna: An Open-Source Framework for Flexible 3D FPGA Architectural Exploration
problem: 3D FPGA design exploration requires extensive manual effort and specialized tools. Limited flexibility in vertical interconnect configurations and no open-source infrastructure.
motivation: Open-source 3D FPGA frameworks enable research and rapid prototyping of advanced packaging technologies, accelerating innovation in heterogeneous computing.
method: Open-source framework for 3D FPGA generation with customizable vertical interconnects. Generates synthesizable RTL and produces complete bitstreams. Supports parametric exploration of 3D architectures.
key_novelty: Open-source 3D FPGA framework with customizable vertical interconnects and end-to-end bitstream generation.
limitations: Performance comparisons and practical deployment results not provided in abstract.
